title: Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies
title_zh: 生成式动作策略长期意图的本体感觉草图

paragraphs.en: Generative robot policies predict short action chunks but lack explicit long-horizon intent. Recent methods expose longer-horizon structure through language plans, subgoal images, or video forecasts, which are costly to generate and still need to be translated into robot motion. Predicting future robot motions avoids this translation, but a dense, time-indexed trajectory requires numerous parameters to cover the full remaining task, and over a short horizon it largely repeats the action chunk and adds little guidance for action generation. We propose Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM), which jointly generate a compact, timing-free sketch of the robot’s remaining joint-space path and a dense executable action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. The sketch parameterizes the path by arc length rather than time, capturing geometric intent invariant to execution timing. Block-causal attention and a staggered denoising schedule maintain directed sketch-to-action dependence, ensuring the action tokens condition on a progressively cleaner sketch throughout sampling. In simulation, PAM improves over its action-only counterparts on Push-T and LIBERO-Long; on four real-world bimanual tasks, it raises success from 47.5% to 75.0%. Project page: https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/ .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式机器人策略能够预测短时的动作片段，但缺乏明确的长期意图。 近期方法通过语言规划、子目标图像或视频预测来揭示更长期的结构，但这些方法的生成成本高昂，且仍需转化为机器人的运动指令。 预测未来的机器人运动可以避免这种转换，但密集的时间索引轨迹需要大量参数才能覆盖整个剩余任务，而在短期范围内，它大多只是重复动作片段，对动作生成提供的指导有限。 我们提出了本体感知动作模型（Proprioceptive Action Models, PAM），该模型在一个统一的 Transformer 去噪器中，联合生成机器人剩余关节空间路径的紧凑、无时间依赖的草图，以及一个密集的可执行动作片段。 该草图以弧长而非时间作为参数来定义路径，从而捕捉到与执行时间无关的几何意图。 块因果注意力和交错的去噪流程维持了从草图到动作的定向依赖关系，确保在采样过程中，动作令牌始终以逐步更清晰的草图为条件。 在模拟实验中，PAM 在 Push-T 和 LIBERO-Long 任务上优于仅生成动作的模型；在四个真实世界的双手任务中，其成功率从 47.5% 提升至 75.0%。 项目页面：https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/ .

paragraphs.en: Generative action policies have become a dominant paradigm for visuomotor robot control, producing temporally coherent commands through action chunking ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Chi et al., 2023 ; Black et al., 2025b ; Reuss et al., 2025 ) . Despite strong performance on short-horizon tasks, these policies remain less effective on long-horizon manipulation ( Fan et al., 2025 ) . One approach to this challenge is to guide action prediction with visual forecasts ( Black et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) , predictive scene latents ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) , or language-based plans and reasoning ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Zawalski et al., 2025 ) . These representations capture anticipated scene evolution or semantic task structure, but can be costly to generate or require additional learned mappings to continuous control. This motivates a compact representation of long-horizon intent closely tied to the robot’s own motion.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式动作策略已成为视觉-运动机器人控制的主流范式，通过动作分块生成时间上连贯的命令（Zhao 等，2023；Chi 等，2023；Black 等，2025b；Reuss 等，2025）。 尽管这些策略在短视域任务中表现优异，但在长视域操作任务中的效果仍然有限（Fan 等，2025）。 应对这一挑战的一种方法是通过视觉预测（Black 等，2024；Hu 等，2025；Tian 等，2025）、预测性场景潜在变量（Zhang 等，2026；Liu 等，2026；Zhu 等，2025）或基于语言的计划与推理（Wen 等，2025；Zawalski 等，2025）来引导动作预测。 这些表示能够捕捉场景的预期演化或任务的语义结构，但其生成成本可能较高，或者需要额外的学习映射才能与连续控制衔接。 这促使我们采用一种紧凑的长视域意图表示方法，使其与机器人自身的运动紧密关联。

paragraphs.en: Future robot configurations provide a natural representation of the robot’s intended motion. Demonstrations contain synchronized proprioceptive measurements, providing supervision without additional annotation in a space directly related to robot control. Prior work has used robot-motion representations to guide action prediction, including image-plane trajectories ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) and predicted end-effector paths ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, a dense, time-indexed configuration trajectory over the full remaining task is long and varies in length across demonstrations, making it difficult to represent with a limited number of parameters. Restricting the prediction to a short horizon instead makes it largely redundant with the executable action chunk, so it provides little additional guidance for action generation. An effective intent representation should therefore cover the full remaining motion with a fixed number of parameters while providing information beyond the action chunk.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的机器人构型为机器人的预期运动提供了自然的表示方式。 演示包含同步的本体感觉测量数据，从而在直接与机器人控制相关的空间中提供监督，而无需额外的标注。 先前的研究已利用机器人运动表示来指导动作预测，包括图像平面轨迹（Gu et al., 2024; Niu et al., 2025）和预测的末端执行器路径（Chen et al., 2026）。 然而，覆盖整个剩余任务的密集、带时间索引的构型轨迹既冗长，又因演示不同而长度各异，因此难以用有限数量的参数来表示。 相反，若将预测限制在较短的时间范围内，则其与可执行的动作片段在很大程度上会重复，因而对动作生成提供的额外指导很少。 因此，一种有效的意图表示应当以固定的参数数量覆盖全部剩余运动，同时提供超出动作片段范围的信息。

paragraphs.en: We introduce the proprioceptive sketch , a compact representation of the robot’s remaining configuration-space path to task completion. The sketch uses arc-length parameterization to remove execution timing and a small number of B-spline coefficients to limit geometric details. In the handoff task in Figure 1 , the sketch describes the arm paths toward the transfer region and around the barrier without specifying motion speed or the duration of the exchange. It provides long-horizon geometric context for predicting a separate, short-horizon action chunk. Only the action chunk is executed, determining the immediate motion and gripper commands.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了本体感觉草图，这是一种对机器人完成任务所需的剩余构型空间路径的紧凑表示。 该草图采用弧长参数化来消除执行时间因素，并使用少量 B-样条系数来限制几何细节。 在图 1 中的交接任务中，该草图描述了机械臂朝向交接区域并绕过障碍物的路径，但未指定运动速度或交换的持续时间。 它为预测一个独立的短期动作片段提供了长期几何上下文信息。 只有动作片段会被执行，从而决定即时的运动和夹爪指令。

paragraphs.en: Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM) jointly generate the sketch and an action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. As illustrated in Figure 1 , both outputs are initialized with Gaussian noise and refined through iterative denoising. A block-causal attention mask allows action tokens to attend to the sketch while preventing sketch tokens from reading the action stream. Following Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , we train the denoiser with varying corruption levels across the two streams and use a staggered denoising schedule that denoises the sketch ahead of the actions, providing cleaner geometric context for action generation.
paragraphs.zh: 本体感觉动作模型（PAM）在单个 Transformer 去噪器中联合生成草图和动作片段。 如图 1 所示，两种输出均以高斯噪声初始化，并通过迭代去噪进行优化。 块因果注意力掩码允许动作令牌关注草图，同时防止草图令牌读取动作流。 遵循扩散强迫方法（Chen 等人，2024），我们在两条流中使用不同的扰动水平训练去噪器，并采用交错的去噪时间表：先对草图进行去噪，再处理动作，从而为动作生成提供更干净的几何上下文。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate the proprioceptive sketch, a compact, timing-free representation of the remaining configuration-space path that serves as an explicit intermediate variable for action generation and is, by construction, invariant to temporal reparameterization of the demonstrated path. Second, we develop a joint generator with directed attention and staggered denoising to guide action prediction with the sketch. Third, we apply PAM to a diffusion transformer trained from scratch (PAM-DP), and a pretrained vision-language-action model (PAM-VLA). We evaluate PAM-DP on Push-T and four real-world bimanual tasks, and PAM-VLA on LIBERO-Long.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面。 首先，我们构建了本体感觉草图，这是一种紧凑且无需时间信息的剩余构型空间路径表示，它作为动作生成的显式中间变量，并且根据设计对演示路径的时间重参数化保持不变。 其次，我们开发了一种带有定向注意力和交错去噪的联合生成器，利用该草图引导动作预测。 第三，我们将 PAM 应用于从头训练的扩散变换器（PAM-DP）以及一个预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型（PAM-VLA）。 我们在 Push-T 和四个真实世界的双手任务上评估了 PAM-DP，并在 LIBERO-Long 上评估了 PAM-VLA。

paragraphs.en: Predictive intermediate representations. Intermediate predictions provide action policies with information about intended behavior. Language-based approaches express task structure through subtask descriptions or reasoning traces ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2025a ; Zawalski et al., 2025 ) . Visual approaches use future images or video to represent goal configurations and scene evolution ( Black et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) . Other methods learn predictive representations of scene dynamics or visuomotor behavior in latent space ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) . These representations describe the task rather than the robot’s own motion, and they are either expensive to generate or require a learned decoder to reach continuous control. PAM instead predicts intended motion as a configuration-space path, which requires no annotation beyond recorded proprioception.
paragraphs.zh: 预测性中间表示。 中间预测为动作策略提供有关预期行为的信息。 基于语言的方法通过子任务描述或推理轨迹来表达任务结构（Wen 等，2025；Black 等，2025a；Zawalski 等，2025）。 视觉方法使用未来的图像或视频来表示目标配置和场景演化（Black 等，2024；Zhao 等，2025；Hu 等，2025；Tian 等，2025）。 其他方法在潜在空间中学习场景动态或视觉运动行为的预测性表示（Zhang 等，2026；Liu 等，2026；Liang 等，2024；Xu 等，2026b）。 这些表示描述的是任务本身，而非机器人自身的运动，并且它们要么生成成本高昂，要么需要通过学习得到的解码器才能实现连续控制。 PAM 则预测预期运动为配置空间中的路径，这无需除记录的本体感觉数据之外的任何标注。

paragraphs.en: Robot-motion representations. Robot motion provides an intermediate representation for planning and control. Hierarchical reinforcement learning uses state-space subgoals to guide lower-level policies ( Nachum et al., 2018 ) . RT-Trajectory conditions action prediction on image-plane trajectory sketches ( Gu et al., 2024 ) , while TraceVLA supplies visual traces of past motion ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . Predictive approaches use future motion in different ways. GeoPredict supervises future keypoint prediction during training ( Qian et al., 2026 ) , whereas OASIS predicts end-effector trajectories that condition a separate action decoder ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Recent spline policies similarly parameterize executable action trajectories with spline coefficients ( Tian et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . PAM likewise predicts future robot motion but differs in three respects: the sketch spans the remaining path to task completion, it removes execution timing through arc-length parameterization, and it is generated jointly with actions in a single denoiser.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人运动表示。 机器人运动为规划和控制提供了一种中间表示。 分层强化学习利用状态空间中的子目标来指导低层策略（Nachum 等人，2018）。 RT-Trajectory 将动作预测与图像平面上的轨迹草图相关联（Gu 等人，2024），而 TraceVLA 则提供过去运动的视觉痕迹（Zheng 等人，2025）。 预测方法以不同方式利用未来运动。 GeoPredict 在训练过程中监督未来关键点的预测（Qian 等人，2026），而 OASIS 则预测末端执行器的轨迹，该轨迹用于条件化一个独立的动作解码器（Chen 等人，2026）。 近期的样条策略同样利用样条系数对可执行的动作轨迹进行参数化（Tian 等人，2026；Han 等人，2026；Yang 等人，2026）。 PAM 同样预测未来机器人运动，但在三个方面有所不同：其草图涵盖了完成任务所需的剩余路径，它通过弧长参数化消除了执行时间信息，并且它与动作在同一个去噪器中联合生成。

paragraphs.en: Joint generation and denoising schedules. Joint world-action models generate actions together with predicted images, video, or scene representations ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . Trajectory-diffusion methods instead generate state-action plans ( Janner et al., 2022 ) from which actions are recovered through inverse dynamics ( Ajay et al., 2023 ) . Diffusion Forcing introduces independent token-level corruption during training, enabling flexible denoising schedules at inference ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . PAM draws on these joint-generation and scheduling principles to couple a non-executable motion sketch with an executable action chunk. Directed attention allows actions to depend on the sketch without feeding action information back into sketch generation, while staggered denoising lets the sketch become cleaner ahead of the actions.
paragraphs.zh: 联合生成与去噪调度。 联合世界-动作模型会同时生成动作以及预测的图像、视频或场景表示（Zhu 等，2025；Ye 等，2026；Lin 等，2026；Xu 等，2026a）。 轨迹扩散方法则通过反向动力学从状态-动作规划中恢复出动作（Janner 等，2022；Ajay 等，2023）。 扩散强迫在训练期间引入独立的词元级扰动，从而在推理时实现灵活的去噪调度（Chen 等，2024）。 PAM 借鉴了这些联合生成与调度原则，将不可执行的运动草图与可执行的动作片段耦合在一起。 定向注意力使动作可以依赖草图，而无需将动作信息反馈到草图生成过程中；同时，交错去噪则允许草图在动作之前逐步变得更清晰。

paragraphs.en: Training target and representation capacity. We construct sketch targets by fitting the remaining configuration path in each demonstration. paragraphs.en: Policies and baselines. We evaluate PAM-DP on Push-T and the real-world tasks, and PAM-VLA on LIBERO-Long. PAM-DP is trained from scratch using diffusion, with transformer-based Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2023 ) as its action-only baseline. PAM-VLA adds the sketch to the rectified-flow action expert of FLOWER ( Reuss et al., 2025 ) , which serves as its pretrained action-only baseline. We also compare with B-spline Policy ( Han et al., 2026 ) , which represents executable actions as spline curves. We compare with the transformer-based Diffusion Policy rather than its convolutional variant, because PAM represents the sketch and actions as token streams in a transformer.

paragraphs.en: Push-T. We evaluate PAM-DP with state and image observations using the dataset and evaluation protocol of Chi et al. (2023) . The configuration 𝐪 t \mathbf{q}_{t} is the measured two-dimensional pusher position, and the sketch represents its remaining path in both observation settings. The state-based setting allows us to examine the sketch without the additional challenge of visual perception. We measure performance by target coverage, the fraction of the target region covered by the block. Table 2 reports the maximum over checkpoints and the mean over the last ten checkpoints, following Chi et al. (2023) , with 3 seeds and 50 initial conditions per evaluation. PAM-DP achieves higher coverage than the action-only transformer and B-spline Policy in both observation settings. Compared with Diffusion Policy, the last-ten checkpoint average increases from 0.79 0.79 to 0.88 0.88 with state observations and from 0.66 0.66 to 0.72 0.72 with image observations. The gains in the checkpoint average indicate that the differences are not limited to the best checkpoint. B-spline Policy, which uses a spline to parameterize executable actions, does not improve over the dense transformer baseline in this setting, whereas using the spline to represent the remaining path alongside dense actions does.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate PAM-DP on a dual-UR3 platform equipped with parallel grippers and three RGB cameras. The policy observes the camera images and robot joint positions, and outputs 14-dimensional joint and gripper commands at 8 Hz. We collect 81, 81, 48, 89 demonstrations for handoff, close lid, fold cloth, and measure, respectively, with randomized initial object placements. In handoff , the arms transfer a loaf of bread from the red board to the blue mat while clearing a barrier. In close lid , one arm places a pot on the red plate while the other aligns and places its lid on the pot. The fold cloth task requires coordinated corner grasps and successive folds, while measure requires the arms to position and hold a tape measure along a loaf. We train and evaluate PAM-DP, transformer-based Diffusion Policy, and B-spline Policy on these tasks. Each method is evaluated over 20 episodes per task, with initial object placements sampled from the same distribution.

paragraphs.en: Task performance. Table 3 reports success rates and completion times. PAM-DP succeeds in 60 of 80 episodes ( 75.0 % 75.0\% ), compared with 38 ( 47.5 % 47.5\% ) for Diffusion Policy and 35 ( 43.8 % 43.8\% ) for B-spline Policy (two-sided Fisher exact test, p < 0.001 p<0.001 for both). The improvement holds on all four tasks despite their different objects and coordination demands. B-spline Policy does not exceed Diffusion Policy on any task, suggesting that the gain comes from representing the remaining path rather than from spline parameterization itself. PAM-DP takes slightly longer on successful episodes, consistent with the additional NFE from the sketch lead and the extra sketch tokens processed at each evaluation.

paragraphs.en: The action-only backbone removes the sketch tokens and sketch loss from PAM-DP. The auxiliary-only variant retains sketch prediction and supervision but removes attention from action queries to sketch keys. Sketch supervision can therefore affect actions through shared parameters, but actions cannot read the sketch tokens. The time-indexed sketch variant replaces uniform arc-length resampling with uniform-time resampling before B-spline fitting, retaining the same control-point count, token budget, loss weights, and attention structure. The bidirectional variant allows all target tokens to attend to one another and to the complete observation memory. The shared-time variant ties the sketch and action noise levels during training, whereas zero lead ties them only during sampling. PAM-DP with zero lead achieves mean coverage of 0.79 0.79 , compared with 0.69 0.69 for the action-only backbone and 0.75 0.75 for auxiliary-only prediction. Time-indexed sketches, bidirectional attention, and shared-time training reduce coverage to 0.74 0.74 , 0.72 0.72 , and 0.74 0.74 , respectively. Each component therefore contributes to performance, even without staggered denoising.
paragraphs.zh: 仅动作主干模型从 PAM-DP 中移除了草图标记和草图损失。 仅辅助变体保留了草图预测和监督，但将注意力从动作查询转移到了草图键上。 因此，草图监督可以通过共享参数影响动作，但动作无法读取草图标记。 时间索引草图变体在 B-样条拟合之前，将均匀弧长重采样替换为均匀时间重采样，同时保留了相同的控制点数量、标记预算、损失权重和注意力结构。 双向变体允许所有目标标记相互关注，并关注完整的观察记忆。 共享时间变体在训练期间将草图和动作的噪声水平绑定在一起，而零领先变体仅在采样期间将它们绑定。 采用零领先的 PAM-DP 实现了 0.79 的平均覆盖率，而仅动作主干模型为 0.69，仅辅助预测为 0.75。 时间索引草图、双向注意力和共享时间训练分别将覆盖率降低至 0.74、0.72 和 0.74。 因此，即使没有交错去噪，每个组件都对性能有所贡献。

paragraphs.en: Sketch-lead sensitivity. We vary the sketch lead with a 16-step DDIM base budget (Table 6 ). We report mean coverage and standard deviation over three sampler-noise seeds, each evaluated on the same 50 initial conditions. All positive leads yield higher mean coverage than zero lead. The default η = 1 / 8 \eta=1/8 , highlighted by shading, increases coverage from 0.779 0.779 to 0.805 0.805 with 18 rather than 16 NFE. Increasing the lead to η = 1 \eta=1 yields 0.809 0.809 coverage but requires 32 NFE. These results support a modest lead as a practical trade-off between coverage and computation. Appendix C.2 details the lead-evaluation protocol.

paragraphs.en: Sketch intervention. We test sketch dependence offline at a fixed handoff observation using routes passing in front of or behind the barrier (Figure 7 a). We hold the observation and initial action noise fixed and replace the sketch denoising trajectory at matching noise levels. Back-route sketches induce greater predicted backward motion of the left gripper (Figure 7 b). At action step 8, different-route replacement changes the predicted left-tool position by 10.5 mm RMS, compared with 8.5 mm for action-noise resampling and 1.5 mm for same-route replacement (Figure 7 c). Changing the sketch route alters the predicted motion even when the observation and action noise remain fixed. Appendix C.3 describes donor selection, noise pairing, and the displacement metric.
paragraphs.zh: 草图干预。 我们在固定的交接观察点处，通过经过屏障前方或后方的路径，离线测试对草图的依赖程度（图 7a）。 我们保持观察和初始动作噪声不变，并在匹配的噪声水平上替换草图去噪轨迹。 反向路径的草图会导致左抓取器预测出的向后运动更大（图 7b）。 在动作步骤 8 中，不同路径的替换使左工具预测位置的变化均方根值达到 10.5 毫米，而动作噪声重采样为 8.5 毫米，相同路径替换则为 1.5 毫米（图 7c）。 即使观察和动作噪声保持不变，改变草图路径也会影响预测的运动。 附录 C.3 描述了供体选择、噪声配对以及位移指标。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Proprioceptive Action Models, which jointly generate a timing-free B-spline sketch of the remaining configuration-space path and a short executable action chunk through directed attention and staggered denoising. Adding the sketch improves over the corresponding action-only policies on Push-T, LIBERO-Long, and four real-world bimanual tasks. Several limitations remain. The sketch represents the robot’s motion without modeling object dynamics or contact. Staggered denoising requires additional NFE, and our lead sweep does not separate the schedule from this added computation. Future work will explore sketches that capture object interactions and evaluate denoising schedules under matched inference budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了本体感觉动作模型，该模型通过定向注意和交错去噪，联合生成剩余构型空间路径的无时间依赖 B-样条草图以及一个简短的可执行动作片段。 在 Push-T、LIBERO-Long 以及四项真实世界的双手任务中，加入草图后的模型表现优于仅使用动作的对应策略。 目前仍存在若干局限性。 该草图描述了机器人的运动，但未对物体动态或接触进行建模。 交错去噪需要额外的 NFE，且我们的领先扫描步骤未将调度与这部分新增的计算分离开来。 未来的工作将探索能够捕捉物体交互的草图，并在匹配的推理预算下评估去噪调度方案。

paragraphs.en: We audit the adopted coefficient budgets after training using a common reconstruction metric. We measure E rec ​ ( M ) E_{\mathrm{rec}}(M) as the scalar RMSE between each fitted path and its 64 uniformly spaced phase targets, weighting anchors, phase samples, and configuration dimensions equally. All capacity audits use training episodes. Push-T and the dual-arm tasks use training-sampler anchors, while LIBERO uses every frame. paragraphs.en: We normalize each predicted coefficient and configuration dimension independently using training-set minima and maxima. In the dual-arm implementation, these statistics use targets indexed by the training sampler; nonconstant dimensions map to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , while nearly constant dimensions retain unit scale and only subtract the training minimum. Separately from the training-set capacity audit, we audit clipping on fitted validation targets by normalizing their coefficients, clamping to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , inverting the transform, and decoding the paths. Scalar reconstruction RMSE changes from 0.568 0.568 to 0.571 0.571 degrees for handoff, 0.528 0.528 to 0.541 0.541 for close lid, 0.563 0.563 to 0.566 0.566 for fold cloth, and 0.596 0.596 to 0.602 0.602 for measure. Push-T remains at 3.08 3.08 pixels at the reported precision. These values measure distortion of fitted targets rather than model prediction error.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用训练集的最小值和最大值，对每个预测的系数和配置维度进行独立归一化。 在双臂实现中，这些统计量使用由训练采样器索引的目标；非常数维度映射到 [−1, 1]，而近似常数的维度则保留单位尺度，仅减去训练最小值。 除了对训练集容量的审核外，我们还通过归一化拟合验证目标的系数、将其夹在 [−1, 1] 范围内、反转变换并解码路径，来审核拟合结果上的裁剪操作。 标量重建的 RMSE 在移交场景下从 0.568 变为 0.571 度，在闭合盖子场景下从 0.528 变为 0.541 度，在折叠布料场景下从 0.563 变为 0.566 度，在测量场景下从 0.596 变为 0.602 度。 Push-T 在报告的精度水平上仍保持在 3.08 像素。 这些数值衡量的是拟合目标的失真程度，而非模型预测误差。

paragraphs.en: The observation encoder processes each timestep independently, combining image and low-dimensional inputs into a feature vector. These features are projected, combined with learned positional embeddings, and passed through a position-wise MLP to form the cross-attention memory. There is no temporal mixing in this conditioning network. Sketch queries read all observation positions, whereas action queries read observation positions up to their own time index, following the transformer Diffusion Policy.

paragraphs.en: Noise conditioning. The main Push-T model uses adaLN-zero conditioning. The sketch and action timesteps are embedded separately and broadcast to the tokens of their respective streams. paragraphs.en: PAM-VLA. PAM-VLA augments FLOWER’s rectified-flow action expert with sketch prediction. Separate MLPs encode sketch coefficients and actions into a shared DiT, and separate linear heads predict their velocities. Rotary positional indices restart at zero for each stream. Sketch self-attention is causal and excludes action keys; actions attend to all sketch tokens and causally to other actions. Projected VLM features provide cross-attention context. Noise-level and control-frequency embeddings condition the tokens and adaptive normalization. The pretrained Florence-2 backbone, including its vision tower, is fine-tuned rather than frozen.
paragraphs.zh: PAM-VLA。 PAM-VLA 将草图预测整合到 FLOWER 的修正流动作专家中。 独立的 MLP 分别对草图系数和动作进行编码，并将其输入共享的 DiT；独立的线性输出层则预测它们的速度。 每个流中的旋转位置索引均从零开始重新计算。 草图的自注意力机制具有因果性，且排除动作键；动作则关注所有草图标记，并对其他动作保持因果性关注。 投影后的 VLM 特征提供了交叉注意力的上下文信息。 噪声水平和控制频率的嵌入对标记和自适应归一化施加条件约束。 预训练的 Florence-2 主干网络（包括其视觉塔）经过微调，而非保持冻结状态。

paragraphs.en: Discrete sketch lead. The Push-T sampler realizes Algorithm 1 as an offset in the inference timestep list, where the normalized coordinates γ Z \gamma_{Z} and γ A \gamma_{A} index a list of K K scheduler timesteps and Update is one DDPM or DDIM step. The requested lead η \eta is converted to an integer offset k lead = ⌊ η ​ K + 0.5 ⌋ ∈ { 0 , … , K } k_{\mathrm{lead}}=\lfloor\eta K+0.5\rfloor\in\{0,\ldots,K\} , rounding half-integer offsets upward. For discrete sampling, Algorithm 1 uses k lead / K k_{\mathrm{lead}}/K in place of η \eta . For K = 100 K=100 and η = 1 / 8 \eta=1/8 , the offset is 13, giving 113 NFE and exactly 100 updates per stream. Both streams start from independent Gaussian noise. The sampler first performs k lead k_{\mathrm{lead}} sketch updates while holding the action noise fixed. It then performs K K action updates, with the sketch advancing through its own schedule k lead k_{\mathrm{lead}} positions ahead. Once the sketch has completed all K K updates, it remains fixed while action denoising finishes. Each model call reads both streams at their current local timesteps, and each active stream uses its own predicted noise 𝐮 \mathbf{u} in the update. This schedule requires K + k lead K+k_{\mathrm{lead}} NFE. Zero lead updates both streams synchronously; a lead of K K completes sketch generation before updating actions. We use η = 1 / 8 \eta=1/8 for the main results. Once the sketch is fixed, its conditioning timestep remains the final index in the scheduler’s inference list.

paragraphs.en: Real-world tasks. Each method is evaluated over 20 episodes per task with initial object placements sampled from the same distribution. Each episode runs for at most 120 s without human intervention; the policy may regrasp autonomously within this limit, and an episode that has not succeeded by 120 s is counted as a failure. In handoff , one arm grasps the loaf and passes it to the other arm around the barrier, which places it on the blue mat. In close lid , the lid rests on the pot and the pot rests on the red plate; the lid need not be fully seated. In fold cloth , the cloth is folded twice into the goal configuration shown in Figure 4 . In measure , the arms extend the tape measure along the loaf and then release it. Completion time is reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over successful episodes only; the overall time pools successful episodes across tasks. Each failed episode receives one label for the earliest error that led to failure, and recovered errors in successful episodes are not counted in Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界任务。 每种方法在每个任务上均通过 20 个回合进行评估，初始物体放置位置从同一分布中采样。 每个回合最多运行 120 秒，期间无人工干预；策略可在该时限内自主重新抓取，若 120 秒内未成功，则视为失败。 在“交接”任务中，一只机械臂抓住面包，绕过障碍物将其传递给另一只机械臂，后者将其放置在蓝色垫子上。 在“闭合盖子”任务中，盖子置于锅上，锅则置于红色盘子上；盖子无需完全扣紧。 在“折叠布料”任务中，布料被两次折叠成图 4 所示的目标构型。 在“测量”任务中，机械臂沿面包展开卷尺，然后将其释放。 完成时间仅针对成功回合报告为均值 ± \pm 标准差；总时间汇总了各任务中所有成功回合的时间。 每个失败的回合都会根据导致失败的最早错误获得一个标签，而成功回合中恢复后的错误不计入表 4。

paragraphs.en: For the real-world tasks, offline checkpoint selection uses EMA predictions and episode-averaged physical joint-action RMSE, averaged over five inference seeds with synchronous 16-step DDIM. All three methods use this selection rule, and robot evaluation episodes are not used for checkpoint selection.
paragraphs.zh: 对于现实世界中的任务，离线检查点选择使用 EMA 预测和按集平均的物理关节动作 RMSE，并在同步 16 步 DDIM 的五次推理种子上进行平均。 所有三种方法都使用这一选择规则，并且机器人评估集不会用于检查点选择。

paragraphs.en: The offline intervention in Figure 7 fixes one handoff observation and the initial action noise, then replaces the sketch denoising trajectory with a donor trajectory at matching noise levels. We use EMA weights and deterministic 16-step DDIM. Donor sketches are expressed relative to the current joint configuration. They are replayed at each action-updating model call, so noisy sketch inputs retain the appropriate corruption level.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 中的离线干预方法会固定一次交接观察值和初始动作噪声，然后用与噪声水平匹配的捐赠轨迹来替代草图去噪轨迹。 我们使用 EMA 权重和确定性的 16 步 DDIM。 捐赠草图是相对于当前的关节配置来表示的。 它们会在每次更新动作的模型调用中被重播，因此带有噪声的草图输入能保持适当的失真程度。

paragraphs.en: At inference step 120 of one episode, we generate 20 native front-route sketches. We take 20 additional front-route donors from the preceding observation and 20 back-route donors from a later observation in the same episode. Each set is paired with the same ten action noises. The different-route comparison uses the two transplanted sets; the same-route comparison uses native and transplanted front-route sets. The noise control varies action noise while holding the sketch fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 在一轮推理的第 120 步，我们生成 20 个本地前路线草图。 我们从该轮之前的观察中选取 20 个额外的前路线捐赠者，并从同一轮之后的观察中选取 20 个后路线捐赠者。 每套数据都与相同的十种动作噪声配对。 不同路线的比较使用两套移植后的数据集；相同路线的比较则使用本地前路线数据集和移植后的前路线数据集。 噪声控制通过改变动作噪声，同时保持草图不变来实现。

paragraphs.en: We measure the root mean squared Euclidean displacement between paired predicted tool positions at each action step, using forward kinematics with the fitted tool reference. This tests action dependence at a fixed observation, not closed-loop task success or collision clearance.
